subject: [PATCH 3/3] mm: vmscan: tell direct reclaim the allocation is ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT

2026-10-28.patch_summary: This patch modifies the direct reclaim process in Linux to pass an additional flag, ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT, from the allocation down to try_to_free_pages(). This allows the allocation to take free pages of any migratetype, rather than being restricted to unmovable and reclaimable pageblocks. The change is intended to improve performance by reducing fragmentation during direct reclaim. The patch was tested on a 64K mTHP benchmark and showed improved results with defrag_mode enabled. The patch builds upon an earlier fix for defrag_mode and addresses the issue of direct reclaim stopping prematurely due to fragmentation.
